baseline: Frozen c40ea95 UI and desktop; same current core, dependencies and synthetic replies in both modes
method: Three alternating fresh Linux Electron pairs for each of large and small workloads. Five post-diagnostic-renderer-GC samples per process; medians within processes then across three processes. No tests or benchmarks run concurrently.

processTree.scope: Linux process-tree sample, not atomic. PSS apportions shared pages; summed RSS double-counts sharing. Hugetlb is separate. Detached/reparented helpers, external model runtimes and display-server/GPU-driver allocations outside these processes are excluded. No forced GC.

scope: Retained memory and DOM at a settled chat position, not natural GC timing, peak memory, app startup latency, total user workload or model RAM/VRAM. All full reply text remains available. Xvfb/display-server and external helpers outside the app process tree are excluded. Small workloads retain the original renderer.
